top.title: India's central bank hikes rates for first time in more than three years
top.teaser: India central bank hike interest rate 25 basis points to 5.5%
top.impact_reason: Influences cross-border investment and buyer purchasing power.
top.headline: India Central Bank Raises Interest Rates
top.summary: India's central bank increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 5.5 percent, marking the first hike in over three years. This shift could impact borrowing costs for investors abroad.
top.why: Changes in home country financing rates directly affect purchasing power and investment behavior of overseas buyers.

top.title: Dubai home sale transactions fall in third quarter due to regional uncertainty
top.teaser: The volume and value of residential property transactions in Dubai fell sharply in the third quarter of this year as buyers became “more cautious” amid regional uncertainty over the Iran war, according to a new report. top.headline: Dubai Property Transactions Drop in Q3
top.summary: Residential property sales volumes and values in Dubai decreased during the third quarter. Market reports indicate that regional uncertainties caused buyers to adopt a more cautious approach.
top.why: Transaction volume and value shifts reflect changing market sentiment and buyer demand.
